note: Mission chain: MISSION 1 to MISSION 8 (the final knowledge challenge), followed by the HERITAGE ARCHIVIST completion status. Objectives are data, not code — the QuestManager reads this file at runtime, so a new objective can be added without recompiling. Objective types: reach, interact, collect, quiz, search, ask_guide, minigame, final.

missions.title: Enter the Digital Heritage Museum
missions.description: Arrive in the central hall of the Digital Ambedkar Heritage Museum and orient yourself: the six gallery doors are on the far wall.

objectives.label: Walk forward into the central hall
Meet the holographic guide at the information desk
Read the labels above the six gallery doors
Open the Digital Archive from the HUD (Tab or the ARCHIVE button)

missions.title: Discover Early Life
missions.description: Walk the rising timeline from 1891 to 1927 and answer the checkpoints.

objectives.label: Enter the Early Life & Education gallery
Examine the birth, school and matriculation exhibits
Listen to the Columbia years narration
Complete the Early Life checkpoint quiz

missions.title: Explore Social Reform
missions.description: The campaigns of 1920 to 1936, with the two centre-hall mini-games: Match the Event and Sort the Timeline.

objectives.label: Enter the Mahad reconstruction and find the water tank
Read both sides of the Poona Pact exhibit

missions.title: Enter the Constitution Gallery
missions.description: Study the circular constitutional table: the Preamble, the Fundamental Rights and Article 32.

objectives.label: Read the Preamble and the Objectives Resolution together
Open two articles from the Fundamental Rights wall
Listen to the reading of the Article 32 extract

missions.title: Search the Manuscript Archive
missions.description: Use the document viewer in the research room: page turns, magnification and metadata.

objectives.label: Open three books in the document viewer
Magnify a page and read its metadata panel

missions.title: Visit Digital Memorials
missions.description: Choose a site on the map table and walk through its labelled reconstruction.

missions.title: Complete the Legacy Archive
missions.description: Search the whole collection, ask the Archive Guide, and review your progress on the achievement wall.

objectives.label: Run three searches in the archive search terminal
Ask the Archive Guide two questions
Play an item from the audio or video archive wall

missions.title: Final Knowledge Challenge
missions.description: Six stages: identify the topic, match the archive entries, arrange the timeline, answer the constitutional questions, identify the documents, and answer the final questions. The completion certificate follows.

objectives.label: Stage 2 — Match archive entries with their descriptions

completion.title: HERITAGE ARCHIVIST
completion.description: Awarded when all six galleries have been completed, the Archive Guide has been consulted and the final knowledge challenge has been passed.

demoFlow.note: DEMO MODE for the SIH presentation. Starts in the museum lobby with a guided objective and reaches all ten demonstration features within 5–10 minutes.

steps.label: Start in the lobby — third-person character, cinematic reveal
steps.guidance: Move with WASD or the joystick. Look with the mouse or by swiping.

steps.label: Six gallery doors, labelled above each frame
steps.guidance: Walk along the far wall — six doors, six galleries.

steps.label: Interactive exhibit — the timeline wall in the hub
steps.guidance: Aim at the panel and press E, or tap INTERACT.

steps.label: Open the archive (Tab / ARCHIVE button)
steps.guidance: Search, filter by category, open an entry and read its source.

steps.label: Document viewer — a manuscript from the research room
steps.guidance: Page turn and magnify; read the metadata panel.

steps.label: Audio-visual exhibit — the speech reading in the Constitution gallery
steps.guidance: Subtitles are on by default and can be switched off in Settings.

steps.label: Educational quiz — the Preamble knowledge check
steps.guidance: Every answer, right or wrong, is followed by the explanation.

steps.label: Ask the Archive Guide a question
steps.guidance: Try “What does Article 32 do?” and look at the records it cites.

steps.label: Digital memorial — Deekshabhoomi reconstruction
steps.guidance: Select it on the map table, then walk through the stupa plaza.

steps.label: Progress dashboard — achievements, discoveries and knowledge points
steps.guidance: The final challenge unlocks once the galleries are complete.

presentationMode.description: An automated guided sequence through museum → character → six doors → archive → manuscript → memorial → quiz → AI assistant → results, for a live judge demonstration.
